# Independent adversarial ECB FX semantic review — r1

Reviewer: fresh local Codex gpt-6.1-sol High on AlexMac, 6 October 2026, separate from the specialist. Reviewed the exact specialist `reconciliation-r1.md`, `decision-r1.json`, `semantic-evidence.json`, `analyze.py`, fetch receipts and packet hashes in `artifact:data-fabric-fx-semantic-sol/`. The programme brief, prior conditional readiness acceptance and applicable review/authoritative-source rules were read. No source or canonical semantic edits, publication, paid requests or Cloud Run execution occurred.

**Root may accept the bounded semantic reconciliation and proposed plan. No blocking, major or minor defect was found in that scope.** Acceptance is a research/semantic decision: it does not select the candidate, approve its implementation policy choices, approve a new core concept, or establish OVDB publication readiness. Preserve `d1-ecb-fx` as promising/conditional with the existing publication blockers.

## Independently verified evidence

All seven repositories were freshly fetched and every `origin/main` SHA matched a separate successful `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main`, as well as the packet pins. Exact receipts are in `remote-receipts.json`; 20 source extracts and their hashes are recorded in `verification.json`. The inspected commits are:

| Repository | Exact current main |
|---|---|
| meaninggraph/core | `982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97` |
| meaninggraph/registry | `b35f25c93be5d09fce7bc385e77cb58b700d925e` |
| modelspec-org/registry | `309882f4f077379ed56e2c64f6002cbd7f9b5558` |
| modelspec-org/cli | `a8de98b4565ae669b6fba00c334b4649c9d40b11` |
| openvaultdb/ovdb | `df454e778c4b8aa296041be6872fd50a913c7955` |
| datatug/datatug | `bc46cc4c848df4b219d113535ebd6698892f95f2` |
| demo-db/adventureworks | `d6537a740c18c8f14aaa58266a2d2506222c43e1` |

1. All five packet file hashes, all five downloaded-source file hashes and all three claimed prior-input hashes match actual bytes. I read the specialist analyzer but did not run it or overwrite its evidence; separate `verify.py` recomputed the fixture evidence.
2. The full frozen ECB XML hash matches its stated input. Independent namespace-based parsing finds 7,106 distinct reference days, 221,122 positive finite decimal observations, 41 quote codes, no duplicate quote/day, and last day 2026-10-02. Unsupported ARS/SAR/DEM/FRF/VEB are absent. Current [ECB reference page](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) independently confirms EUR base and informational purpose. The [23 June 2026 framework](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/pdf/exchange/Frameworkfortheeuroforeignexchangereferencerates.en.pdf), methodology sections 2 and 2.5, distinguishes setting and publication and describes quote/trade inputs; quote midpoints supply no day-average or final-day equivalence. These support packet lines 29–48.
3. The exact AW main CSV independently reproduces 13,532 rows, one USD base, 14 quote codes, naive midnight dates, uniqueness, every per-code coverage count and all five negative codes. Pinned source descriptions distinguish obtained date/time, day average and final day. On 2022-05-30 the CSV stores average 1.5491/final 1.5500 for USD→AUD, while frozen ECB legs 1.4982 AUD/EUR and 1.0764 USD/EUR yield the packet's 50-digit demonstration. Saturday 2022-06-04 exists in AW and is absent in ECB. Registered AW pin `5028a27189b487d6fd8025fafc1307aada707fd2` has identical FX CSV, both model forms and meaning bytes to current main. This supports lines 52–64, with comparison scope rather than equivalence to the original AW rates.
4. I independently fetched CLDR XML at immutable commit `acd6d88ae493633240e19a87a721076a8a75c310`, checked its 399,951 bytes/hash and queried the current release-48 tag (receipt: `cldr-remote-receipt.json`). The commit is the reproducibility anchor; the tag is only a verified locator. The separate full join recomputes the complete 1–21 histogram, zero unmatched frozen observations and 21 USD regions on 2022-05-30, including US/EC/PA. [LDML currency semantics](https://unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35-numbers.html#Supplemental_Currency_Data) confirms region assignments, tender default, ordering and transition zones; [LDML date ranges](https://unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35.html#Date_and_Date_Ranges) confirms inclusive date-only endpoints. This supports lines 68–72 only as regional day-context enrichment, without an inferred region, observation instant or worldwide validity claim.
5. Exact MeaningGraph core `FORMAT.md`, schema, assets and calendar files support currency/date reuse, local bindings, exact `codes.alpha`, no value inheritance, a supplied bounded local list and omitted optional source licence with descriptive URL/note. Core currency presently lists only USD/EUR/GBP. ModelSpec CLI permits date and decimal; AW model uses decimal rate properties. Existing registries pin actual model/meaning files. No executable new FX artifacts were reviewed or accepted. Lines 76–80 remain a proposed canonical plan subject to artifact validation.
6. Live [ECB copyright terms](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/using-our-site/disclaimer/html/index.en.html) support the packet's attribution/modification/sold-document notices and author-document exception. Exact current OVDB publisher `manifest.go:316` requires `licences.data`; `publisher.go:21` and `:111–114` enforce the 18 known IDs, with `data_licence.go` permitting only bounded known-ID conjunctions. Publisher allowed keys supply no custom-terms reference. Consequently descriptive MeaningGraph provenance does not close canonical publisher acceptance. The packet correctly retains this distinction at lines 84–88.

## Accepted boundary and retained gates

Accept native quote semantics, explicit base/quote direction, reference calendar day, exact raw decimal preservation, same-date/same-snapshot algebra and visible absence. Accept AW comparison as transformable only within the measured day fixture; average/final equivalence remains incompatible. Accept CLDR tender-true regional day-context as zero-to-many, with intervals/zones/ordering and provenance preserved. No successor substitution, previous-date fallback, country-to-currency inference, aggregation of multiplied CLDR quote rows, implicit conversion or cross-currency totals is accepted.

The report already makes identity handling, general timestamp policy, output precision/rounding, new meaning review and serving implementation later gates. This review does not resolve those choices. ECB custom-terms representation, product-specific sold-document notices, updater/corrections/last-good freshness/resource measurements, exact-decimal storage/wire behavior, canonical validators, registry/Directory acceptance and the actual DataTug browser journey remain open. Existing W1 scope, other candidates/W2–W7 and B1/F1–F6 remain preserved.

Evidence limits: historical calculations use the specified frozen full XML through 2026-10-02, not a fresh full-history download. The live reference page showed 2026-10-05, consistent with the packet's later daily source and explicit stale-history limit. No SDMX parity, legal approval for a paid product, canonical artifact validation, runtime query behavior, publication, refresh implementation or browser acceptance was tested. A live source-methodology contradiction, a fixture count/rate-direction mismatch, or a demonstrated accepted custom-terms publisher path would falsify the corresponding conclusion; none was found in this inspection.

VERDICT: blockers=0 majors=0 minors=0 land=yes
